messages:
Priya S: Heads-up: StellarBank sec review call tomorrow 15:00 PT. They want details on RBAC change windows, audit exports, KMS HSM proofs, vuln triage cadence, and IR SLAs. I'll start the prep notes here — please add any ask/answers we should bring.

Maria H: Can we confirm RBAC change freeze window for Dedicated? They asked if we can do rolling role changes without tenant downtime.

Dylan: Yes — we support role updates via SCIM for SSO or API for service accounts. Typical pattern: create new role, migrate principals, then deprecate old. No tenant restart. Example: `PATCH /tenants/{id}/roles`

Jamie L: Add note: audit logging captures role assignment events with actor, target, and before/after. Retention default 365d for enterprise plan. We can provide JSON export.

Priya S: Customer asked for log proof/chain. What's our canonical export for audit proof?

Maria H: We can provide signed log batches via logchain SHA256 manifest and timestamp. Format: daily gz JSONL + manifest.sig (KMS-signed).

Dylan: KMS question: they want HSM key provenance. We did BYO-HSM or Cloud HSM options. Document that private deployments can use customer HSM + key wrapping. Public hosted: we use cloud-KMS + rotation logs.

Priya S: Include sample statement for pre-call: 'We export audit logs as JSONL, include event_type, actor, timestamp, resource, pre/post state, and an HMAC manifest signed by a customer-visible key.'

Jamie L: For vuln triage: SLA is 24h ack, 72h P1 mitigation plan, follow enterprise incident cadence. We track via internal tracker -> CVE mapping. Add link to triage playbook: https://internal.redwood/sec/triage

sec-bot: Reminder: Incident runbook v3 pushed to #eng-oncall at 5321010000

Priya S: Customer asked for SIEM ingest—do we push via syslog/S3? What's recommended?

Dylan: Options: 1) S3 bucket with daily partitioned gz JSONL (recommended), 2) streaming Kinesis/pubsub for near-real-time, 3) syslog for on-prem. Include sample S3 retention policy and bucket policy snippet.

Dylan: ```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Sid": "AllowRedwoodWrite", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": ["arn:aws:iam::REDSRV:role/redwood-exporter"]}, "Action": ["s3:PutObject"], "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::stellarbank-audit/*"]}
  ]
}
```

Jamie L: Also highlight masking: embeddings/PII redaction is configurable. Default: detokenize & redact PII on write; raw content never leaves customer's private dedicated instance.

Priya S: IR escalation path: customer gets pager + email + weekly RCA within 7d for P1. SLA specifics in contract but we can offer extended IR SLAs for dedicated.

Maria H: Add `exportable_audit_window` options: 90/180/365 and custom. For StellarBank suggest 365 + 7d hot window for quick queries.

Priya S: Thanks — I'll consolidate and share slides. Any other asks?

Jamie L: Be ready to show sample manifest: `manifest: {date: \"2026-03-22\", sha256: \"abc123...\"}` and how to verify with our public key.

Dylan: I'll attach sample scripts after call.

sec-bot: Note: created doc stub at https://docs.redwood/sec/stb-onboarding-reqs

Priya S: :thumbsup: perfect. I'll run through with Solutions before call 14:00 PT.
